sections.label: Pallavi
sections.ta:
நெஞ்சில் அலைகள் வந்து மோதுதடி
கஞ்சி வரதனைக் கண்ட பின்னாலே
sections.translit:
nenjil alaigaL vandhu mOdhudhadi
kanji varadhanaik kaNda pinnAlE
sections.en: A jumble of thoughts are pounding on my heart like the ocean’s waves, after catching a glimpse of Varadhan of Kanchi.

sections.label: Anupallavi
sections.ta:
கெஞ்சிய வரங்களைத் தந்திடும் ராஜன்
வஞ்சியை வதைப்பதின் காரணம் என்னவோடி
sections.translit:
kenjiya varangaLaith thandhidum rAjan
vanjiyai vadhaippadhin kAraNam ennavOdi
sections.en: Why is my king torturing this damsel – despite his compassionate nature, he who grants boons in response to his devotees’ entreaties?

sections.label: Charanam
sections.ta:
ஆனான அயனுக்கும் மறதி கூடாதென்றவர்
மானான என்னை மறந்த மாயமுமென்னவோ
தெருமுனை கண்ட பல்லிக்கு சுய உரு தருவேன் என்றடமோ
தருவினைத் தழுவிட துடித்திடும் கொடிபோல் என்
sections.translit:
AnAna ayanukkum maRadhi kUdAdhendRavar
mAnAna ennai maRandha mAyamumennavO
therumunai kaNda pallikku suya uru tharuvEn endRadamO
tharuvinaith thazhuvida thuditthidum kodipOl en
sections.en: What is the flimsy reason for him to forget this lovely deer? Isn’t he the same person who castigated the great Brahma that he should never have memory lapses? Did he get sidetracked by seeing a lizard on the street? Is he throwing a tantrum, stating that he would instantly restore the lizard’s original form as in its past birth? My heart is in the state of a creeper that longs to embrace a tree for support.

notes: The charanam in this song has references to Varadaraja Perumal offering relief to two youths who were cursed to become lizards by Gautama Rishi, for their negligence in leaving water unattended for the puja. The youths regained their original forms with the Lord’s grace. Another story that is weaved in here relates to Brahma forgetting his routine function of creation. Lord Hari chastises him for it and finally offers him the srishti dhanda after a severe yagna. The sections on Two Lizards and Varadaraja Incarnation in Hastigiri in the following link provide details for the charanam lines 1 and 3. Lizards transformed, Brahma gets power of creation again Another story in a different time frame and location relates to Brahma descending on Varkala, Kerala. He chooses a serene location for the yagna and starts to prepare, and forgets his duty of creation. Lord Vishnu follows him to Varkala to remind him of this duty. Brahma’s lapse of memory in Varkala
